adds.title: G1 - Governo publica portaria com direitos para presos gays e travestis (Portaria SDH/PR 419/2014)
adds.summary: G1 (17 Apr 2014): the Secretaria de Direitos Humanos da Presidência da República published a federal portaria setting where LGBT prisoners are housed across Brazil's prison system, which applies in Minas Gerais' state system: transsexual men and women must be forwarded to female prison units; gay and travesti prisoners held in male prisons must be offered specific conviviality spaces; LGBT inmates may use their social name (which must appear in the admission record) and choose male or female clothing. No sanctions are provided for non-compliance, and the report documents no Minas Gerais-specific implementation, wing, segregation practice or case.

records.note: 1 verified add (national rule, applies throughout the state system): under the federal SDH portaria of 17 Apr 2014, trans prisoners in Brazilian state prison systems - including Minas Gerais - are housed by gender identity: trans men and trans women are forwarded to female prison units, gay/travesti prisoners in male prisons get specific conviviality spaces, and social-name use is a right. The single mandated enwiki full-text search ('transgender prisoners Minas Gerais') returned only generic hits (LGBTQ rights in Brazil, Transgender quotas in Brazil, historical Brazil articles) with no Minas Gerais-specific trans-prisoner placement, unit, solitary/segregation practice or documented case; the fetches were the enwiki 'LGBTQ rights in Brazil' article (which cites this portaria as the prison-placement rule) and the G1 article. No state-specific MG documentation found within budget; CNJ Resolution 507/2023 (the current CNJ framework on trans people in the prison system) was not retrievable within budget.
